seo.title: No-show calculator — how much you lose a year | Seene
seo.description: Work out how much a beauty pro loses to no-shows, late cancellations and regulars who drifted away. Three sliders, one yearly figure.

title: How much do no-shows and forgotten clients cost you?
description: Move the sliders. We count only direct losses: empty slots and visits that never happened.
noShows: No-shows and late cancellations a month
lostNote: A “disappeared” client came regularly and didn’t book again. We assume she would have come once a month.
payback: Pro pays for itself if you win back

how.title: How Seene wins this money back

remind.title: A reminder the day before
remind.text: In the evening: tomorrow’s clients and one button to remind them on WhatsApp.

confirm.title: Confirmation
confirm.text: See who confirmed and who is silent. You can give the slot to someone else in time.

recall.title: “Time to invite”
recall.text: Clients who haven’t been in a while, with a ready message and your free slots.
